full_judgment: 2. Plaintiff-Respondent Nos. 1, 2 and others instituted OC Suit No. 612 of 1966 in the Court of Sadar Munsif Rajshahi, renumbered as OC Suit No. 507 of 1968 and subsequently again renumbered as OC Suit 231 of 1986 of the Court of Munsif, 3rd Court, Nawabganj, impleading the Deities Sree Durgapara Thakurain, Sree Kalimantan Thakurain and Sree Kartick Deb Thakur represented by the Shehayet Sree Bobs Chandra Das and several others as defendants for declaration that the decree passed in OC Suit No. 228 of 1960 (in respect of the suit property) is illegal, void fraudulent and not binding upon them. On the death of the Shehayet his heirs viz Sree Chittaranjan Das, Sree Ranjan Das and Sree Harendra Nath Das were substituted as defendants. On 27-9-86 the appellant, an Advocate of Nawabganj Bar, as the Secretary of Protap Chandra Das Debater Trust Committee filed an application under Order 22 rule 10 read with section 145 of the Code of Civil Procedure for being added as defendant in the suit stating, inter alia, that Late Protap Chandra Das, a businessman of Nawabganj in the year 1332 BS dedicated the suit properties to his family Deities, mentioned above, by registered Arapaima. Last Shebayet Chita Ranjan Das migrated to India in 1981 without making any arrangement to perform Sheba puja and look after the debater property that the local Hindu community in a meeting held on 31-12-81 formed a broad-based trust committee and elected the appellant as its Secretary, that since the said property has devolved upon the trust committee he as the Secretary of the committee for the ends of justice should be made legal representative of the Deities to defend the suit.
